Porel's career is now overshadowed by these ongoing legal proceedings.

Police recovered a note from the room detailing marital discord. The father confessed to strangling his children before his arrest.

title: Google's AI safety team tells job seekers: Skip our AI, talk to a human

Other companies also increasingly use AI in their hiring processes.

title: ‘For now, I am the captain’: Afridi breaks silence on Babar captaincy reports

title: Mark Zuckerberg's $300M yacht booed over rescue call; clarification issued
content: Mark Zuckerberg's superyacht Launchpad faced criticism after a stranded boat incident. The vessel's crew was reportedly on a different radio channel during the emergency. Help was already en route when the yacht's crew reviewed the assistance request. The yacht, valued at $390 million, was closer to the distressed skiff. Passengers on a nearby cruise ship booed the yacht's perceived inaction.

title: New Haven landfill becomes solar farm powering 200 homes

With anticipated revenue exceeding $1.4 million over two decades, this venture supports New Haven's dedication to enhancing its renewable energy initiatives, ultimately benefitting both the environment and the local economy.

title: Yonkers uncovers buried river, creating 14,000 sq ft of aquatic habitat
content: In 2012, Yonkers, New York, completed a project to uncover a section of the Saw Mill River that had been buried beneath a downtown parking lot since the 1920s. The former Larkin Plaza was turned into a three-acre public park. Within six months, the restored river supported 14,000 square feet of new aquatic habitat and several species.

title: Accenture CEO Julie Sweet makes an 'August request' to employees
content: Accenture has implemented a new policy allowing employees to carry over their unused vacation days, aiming to bolster business performance as the fiscal year winds down. CEO Julie Sweet has urged employees to maximize their efforts in these critical weeks. However, this adjustment may inadvertently dissuade workers from taking necessary breaks, raising concerns among investors following a decline in new bookings.

title: Rs 10, Rs 20 polymer notes get field-trial nod: What will change from paper currency?
content: India is preparing to roll out polymer banknotes for initial trials shortly. The Reserve Bank of India plans to launch one billion pieces each of Rs 10 and Rs 20 denominations. These innovative polymer notes will coexist with current paper currency, with the goal of improving the longevity of lower denomination notes. Additionally, parliament discussions included topics on inflation and taxation strategies.

title: Yeida to launch 2 residential plot schemes near Noida airport during Navratri

The Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority is gearing up to unveil two new residential plot schemes aimed at low-income groups and the general public. Strategically located near the Noida International Airport, these initiatives come on the heels of a previous successful allotment of 973 plots, though prior applicants will not qualify this time around.

title: As Gulf tensions reach Bab el-Mandeb, Indian Navy escorts cargo ships through troubled waters
content: Indian naval ships are escorting cargo vessels through the Bab El Mandeb strait.  The INS Trishul and INS Aditya are currently providing this vital maritime security.  These operations ensure the safe transit of energy cargo and protect national interests.  The navy has maintained anti-piracy patrols in the Gulf of Aden since 2008.  Operation Sankalp, launched in 2019, has become a cornerstone of India's maritime security.

title: Indian Army’s tech leap: 6G, quantum, AI cloud and 300 capability projects in the works
content: The Indian Army is significantly modernizing its forces through advanced technology adoption.  It is integrating technologies like 6G and quantum computing into its operations.  Indigenous procurement of defense equipment is rapidly increasing, with a strong focus on domestic vendors.  The army is also developing in-house drone systems for autonomous weapon capabilities.  These initiatives aim to enhance digital infrastructure and weapon systems for future conflicts.

title: 19-year-old gang-raped by 6 men near Mumbai
content: A 19-year-old woman was allegedly gang-raped by six men in Palghar district.  Her boyfriend was beaten and chased away by the assailants on a deserted road.  Police have arrested three accused individuals while searching for the others.  The incident occurred after the couple's two-wheeler skidded near Aamgaon on Sunday.  The survivor underwent a medical examination and is reported to be stable.

title: Kitchen confidential: Rot, raids and reality checks from Mumbai and Bengaluru
content: Recent inspections revealed expired food and poor hygiene in Bengaluru kitchens. Mumbai also saw increased enforcement targeting food outlets and warehouses. These violations highlight systemic issues throughout the food supply chain. Luxury hotels are not exempt from these critical food safety concerns. Effective monitoring and follow-up are essential for ensuring consumer safety.

title: Overtake, chase, hockey sticks, baseball bats: Mumbai man attacked in road rage
content: A fitness trainer and his wife were traumatized by a road-rage incident in Bandra. Five men in an SUV allegedly assaulted the trainer and damaged his car. The incident began when the accused vehicle obstructed the trainer's path. Police detained three individuals and registered a case under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita. Further investigation into the matter is currently underway.

title: Kangana slams Naseeruddin: 'Hai iss desh ke, ladte hai padosi desh ke liye'

This controversy escalated after Shah previously admonished Bollywood for its silence on student protests. In response, Mishra challenged Shah's own record on similar issues, leading Ranaut to launch a fierce critique, branding Shah a fox.

title: ‘You guys cheat’: Pathan reveals Sangakkara clash that turned ‘personal’
content: Irfan Pathan reminisced about a heated exchange with Kumar Sangakkara during a 2005 Test match over a changed cricket ball. What started as personal sledging led to Pathan responding fiercely while scoring 93 runs. Although the tension could have soured their relationship, a later encounter in the IPL with Kings XI Punjab allowed Pathan to extend an apology, paving the way for their newfound friendship.

title: Jana Nayagan box office day 20: Vijay’s film nears Rs194 crore in India

Its worldwide gross collection has now reached Rs 318.09 crore.  Overseas markets have contributed Rs 93.20 crore to the film's total.  The political action drama stars Pooja Hegde and Bobby Deol.

Appointed as the vice-captain for the East Zone team, this role not only acknowledges his talent but is designed to prepare him for future leadership. The Duleep Trophy will be an important opportunity for Sooryavanshi to hone his skills in longer format cricket.

title: Rio turns discarded salon hair into barriers that protect mangroves from oil
content: Discarded human hair is now preventing oil pollution in Rio de Janeiro's Guanabara Bay.  Each gram of hair absorbs approximately five grams of oil, repelling water effectively.  These hair barriers, made from salon waste, can remain in the water for four months.  The initiative protects vulnerable mangrove ecosystems from chronic and everyday oil leaks.  This innovative project aims to aid the recovery of the bay's marine life.

title: Op Safed Sagar: How IAF took the fight to Pakistan at 18,000 feet in Kargil
content: The Indian Air Force launched Operation Safed Sagar against Pakistani intruders.  Pilots faced unprecedented challenges fighting at extreme altitudes.  Early setbacks led to tactical reassessments and technological adaptations.  Mirage-2000 aircraft with laser-guided bombs proved highly effective.  These air attacks significantly aided ground troops in recapturing key peaks.

title: Faulty Ola scooter, no proper service: Consumer panel orders Rs 1.04 lakh refund

Ola Electric must now pay compensation and complaint costs within thirty days.

content: Join conversation Share your thoughts in the comments Be respectful ·  TOI community guidelines Chethan Kumar is a Senior Assistant Editor with the Times of India. Aside from specialising in Space & Science, he has reported extensively on varied topics, with special focus on defence, policy and data stories. He has covered multiple elections, too. As a young democracy grows out of adolescence, Chethan feels, there are reels of tales emerging which need to be captured. To do this, he alternates between the mundane goings-on of the Common Man and the wonder-filled worlds of scientists and scamsters, politicians and soldiers. In a career spanning nearly 18 years, he has reported from multiple datelines — Houston, Florida, Kochi, Hyderabad, Chennai, Sriharikota (AP), NH-1 (J&K Highway), New Delhi, Ahmedabad, Raichur, Bhatkal, Mysuru, Chamarajanagar, to name a few —  but is based out of Bengaluru, India’s science capital that also hosts the ISRO HQ.
